points: The kings on this side Jordan, in the hills, in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite. These are Hamites, better known as Nilotic Africans.

note.label: Joshua 9: The Gibeonite Deception and the Weight of an Oath

points: The Lord sent the pestilence upon Israel from the morning to the time appointed, and there died seventy thousand men from Dan to Beersheba. When the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the Lord repented him of the evil and said to the angel, It is enough, stay now thine hand; and the angel was by the threshing place of Araunah the Jebusite.

note.label: 2 Samuel 24: David Numbers Israel and Buys the Threshing Floor

points: The angel commanded Gad to tell David to set up an altar in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, and David went up at the word spoken in the name of the Most High.

Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite. This threshingfloor was read of a few days ago in First Chronicles 21.
He that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite. Those that remain are the ones who will reverence Israel and serve.
